dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Pronounced concave spline on the trailing edge, originating from a wide posterior ridge and tapering to an acute apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Narrowly rounded acute apex with minimal pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 35-degree inclination of the convex anterior margin relative to the mid-body horizontal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: 1.3:1 ratio of base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly continuous convex arc with a large radius forming the forehead region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt rostrum with a length roughly equal to its basal thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Clear obtuse angle at the transition point between the melon and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan-green pixel values across the entire silhouette; presence of a wide-span caudal fluke with a deep central notch.
